corrections.trigger: The run used MaxPositionQuantity and admission could rely on opposing pending orders, cancellation-requested exposure, or a breach-reducing order that could overshoot the opposite cap.
corrections.reason: Independently fillable orders can reach a different position path and decision set under the corrected cap.

corrections.trigger: A general Strategy run used trade_lag greater than one heartbeat.
corrections.reason: Older runs could expose orders to simulators before the configured lag elapsed.

corrections.trigger: The run used equity, bracket, or VWAP entry sizing with a non-unit contract multiplier, or relied on bracket notional caps or no-stop VWAP allocation.
corrections.reason: Corrected quantities and contract allocation can change orders, fills, risk, and P&L.

corrections.trigger: VWAPMarketSimulator forced a fill at a calendar-day boundary before the requested end time.
corrections.reason: Future prices and volumes could change the historical fill price and P&L.

corrections.trigger: A VWAP order used an infinite, boolean, or non-real stop, or a missing, malformed, or reversed execution window.
corrections.reason: The corrected engine rejects these terms; an old successful result is outside the supported input contract.

corrections.trigger: A rule, risk policy, or simulator mutated protected order identity/lifecycle fields, returned opposite-direction or aggregate overfills, or emitted trades with invalid order references or chronology.
corrections.reason: The old output depended on callback behavior that the corrected execution contract rejects and cannot be repaired after the fact.

corrections.trigger: Orders or fills used non-whole/non-finite quantities or invalid numeric terms, or any weighted price, realized/unrealized P&L, cost, aggregate P&L, or equity result overflowed binary64.
corrections.reason: The corrected engine rejects the input or arithmetic instead of publishing a financially invalid value.
